about.title: About - Nuzlocke Tracker
about.description: About Nuzlocke Tracker, a free app for recording Pokémon Nuzlocke runs: who makes it, the credits, and how it keeps your runs in your browser.

badge.title: Badge details - Nuzlocke Tracker
badge.description: The leader's team, levels and moves for a badge in your Nuzlocke run.

builder.title: Team Builder - Nuzlocke Tracker
builder.description: Build a team from the Pokémon you caught in your Nuzlocke run, then check its type coverage and weaknesses.

calculator.title: Damage Calculator - Nuzlocke Tracker
calculator.description: A Pokémon damage calculator for Nuzlocke runs: damage ranges and KO chances between your Pokémon and the next trainer's, for generations 1 to 8.

changelog.title: Changelog - Nuzlocke Tracker
changelog.description: What's new in Nuzlocke Tracker: every release's features, updates and fixes.

delete.title: Accounts discontinued - Nuzlocke Tracker
delete.description: Nuzlocke Tracker no longer has accounts. Your runs are saved in your browser.

import.title: Import a backup - Nuzlocke Tracker
import.description: Load a Nuzlocke Tracker backup file to restore your runs.

report.title: Report a problem - Nuzlocke Tracker
report.description: Report a bug or suggest an improvement for Nuzlocke Tracker.

rules.title: Nuzlocke Rules - Nuzlocke Tracker
rules.description: Nuzlocke rules for your run: the classic rules, Hardcore, Egglocke, Wonderlocke, Soul Link and more rulesets, or write your own.

settings.title: Settings - Nuzlocke Tracker
settings.description: Choose the language, theme, statuses and how the tracker looks.

stats.title: Run Stats - Nuzlocke Tracker
stats.description: Your Nuzlocke run in numbers: encounters, team, fainted and boxed Pokémon, and a summary image to share.

tracker.title: Nuzlocke Tracker - Track pokemon encounters
tracker.description: The best online app to track and record nuzlocke encounters and pokemon. Including level caps, custom games, all routes, and pokémon up to generation 8.
